title: Moss and the Cool Days
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 1 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds oa, oo, oo (book)
note_for_grown_ups: Non-fiction, Phase 3, 41-sound stage (oa, oo, short oo just added). Simple true facts about hedgehogs getting ready for cooler weather, told through Moss.

pages.text: Moss has a coat of pins.
pages.illustration: Close view of Moss the hedgehog's spiky brown back, in a garden with leaves starting to fall.

pages.text: The sun is not as hot.
pages.illustration: A garden scene with a paler autumn sun and a few fallen leaves on the ground.
Moss the hedgehog with his nose down in the soil, digging busily.

pages.text: Moss gets a good look at the mud.
pages.illustration: Close view of Moss the hedgehog peering closely at a patch of dark mud.
Moss the hedgehog lifting his head with a small beetle near his nose.

pages.text: Soon it will not be hot.
pages.illustration: A garden scene with more fallen leaves scattered on the grass, a cooler grey sky.
Moss the hedgehog curled up asleep in a pile of dry leaves.
Moss the hedgehog peeking out happily from his leaf pile, autumn leaves all around.
